# A test whose root holds a `ui.window` snapshots that window as the program
# draws it (#299). The harness used to append the window's box to a box of its
# own, in a window of its own: gtk4 drew a bare title bar over content given no
# height, and fyne nothing at all, since a Toplevel is no container it draws.
# BuildUI now shows the root's window as the application's root does, gtk4's
# through gtk4rt.ToplevelWindow and fyne's as its content box.
#
# Each pair differs only in one thing the window draws: its title, its back
# button, its menu button, or a row 250px down its scroll. fyne draws no
# title or menu in the window's canvas, so only the back and the row are
# asserted there. Every snapshot after the first is in a new harness window,
# which builds its own bar. android and html drew the window already, and are
# held to the same pairs.

env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'
! cmp app.sngl.snapshots/first.png app.sngl.snapshots/retitled.png
! cmp app.sngl.snapshots/retitled.png app.sngl.snapshots/back.png
! cmp app.sngl.snapshots/back.png app.sngl.snapshots/row.png
! cmp app.sngl.snapshots/first.png app.sngl.snapshots/plain.png

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'
! cmp app.sngl.snapshots/retitled.png app.sngl.snapshots/back.png
! cmp app.sngl.snapshots/back.png app.sngl.snapshots/row.png

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'
! cmp app.sngl.snapshots/robolectric/first.png app.sngl.snapshots/robolectric/retitled.png
! cmp app.sngl.snapshots/robolectric/retitled.png app.sngl.snapshots/robolectric/back.png
! cmp app.sngl.snapshots/robolectric/back.png app.sngl.snapshots/robolectric/row.png
! cmp app.sngl.snapshots/robolectric/first.png app.sngl.snapshots/robolectric/plain.png

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'
! cmp app.sngl.snapshots/first.html app.sngl.snapshots/retitled.html
! cmp app.sngl.snapshots/retitled.html app.sngl.snapshots/back.html
! cmp app.sngl.snapshots/back.html app.sngl.snapshots/row.html
! cmp app.sngl.snapshots/first.html app.sngl.snapshots/plain.html

-- app.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component rows(third string) ui.node {
    ui.vbox(style={flex=1}) {
        ui.scroll(style={flex=1}) {
            ui.vbox {
                ui.text(value="row 1", style={height=120px})
                ui.text(value="row 2", style={height=120px})
                ui.text(value=third, style={height=120px})
                ui.text(value="row 4", style={height=120px})
                ui.text(value="row 5", style={height=120px})
            }
        }
    }
}

component app root {
    var title = "Barred"
    var deep = false
    var third = "row 3"

    ui.window(title=title, canGoBack=deep, @back { deep = false }) {
        component menu {
            ui.menuItem(label="Size") {
                ui.menuItem(label="Small")
            }
        }
        rows(third=third)
    }
}

component plain root {
    ui.window(title="Barred") {
        rows(third="row 3")
    }
}

app()

func testTheWindowIsDrawn(t test.Test, c app) {
    t.snapshot("first")
    c.title = "Retitled"
    t.snapshot("retitled")
    c.deep = true
    t.snapshot("back")
    c.third = "changed"
    t.snapshot("row")
}

func testAWindowWithNoMenu(t test.Test, c plain) {
    t.snapshot("plain")
}
